shortPathGeometry.fixedCutoffIdentity: The native χ is 0 near Xa and 1 near Xb; all positive jets of χ and ρ vanish locally. Tχ is I on inner and minus the short right integral on outer.
shortPathGeometry.pressureRhoP: Its exact torus-independent contribution is zero under the centered inverse. Fixed endpoint Wrr traces vanish by original flatness.
shortPathGeometry.realizedGammaA1: A1=χ_R/R times the original whole integral, hence zero on each narrow open collar.
shortPathGeometry.meanPotentialBeta: The native left-minus-cutoff-whole primitive retains both translated endpoints before replacing it by its short oriented interval.

logBudget.optionalSecondGaussianPoleAbsorption: Use exp(-1/x^2)*x^-p <= ceil(p/2)! for p<=36, costing at most 2^53.

complement.domain: u>1/128 and d>1/32 on the admitted open annulus
complement.mixedTemporalFiveMapHaar: Exactly zero since FiveMap is torus-independent and normalized Temporal Haar is zero.
complement.compactProductSupport: e*X0<X<e^2*X0; actual compact field provided by C102 through these mixed derivatives.
complement.scope: The complement plus the two disjoint narrow collars covers the admitted annulus for all 36 requested product jets.

uniformSingleGaussianProductBudget.coordinates: Original ordinary (R,Z,T), T=0 for every requested derivative

scope: All original initialized mean quadratic products needed by C99, on the narrow collars plus their complement. Centered Temporal has zero Haar mean, and FiveMap has zero jets on the narrow collars. The original C99 linear compact terms, Forced covariance, exterior stress and downstream global Sigma require their separate joins.
